prompt.text:
Implement `packCompiledRecords(records, options)`.

`records` must be an array of objects with string properties `location`, `source`, and `format`. Validate every record before processing; malformed input throws `TypeError`. Only records whose `format` is exactly `"compiled"` are eligible. `options` must contain `makeKey(location)`, boolean `debug`, and string `base`; it may contain `accept(record)`, which defaults to accepting every eligible record. `accept` is called only for eligible records and must return a boolean.

For each accepted record, in input order, call `makeKey` once. It must return a non-negative safe integer or a `TypeError` is thrown. Produce a tuple containing a new shallow copy of the record and two newly allocated buffers. The first buffer contains `JSON.stringify({ key, debug, relative }) + "\n"`, where `relative` is the location with the exact `base + "/"` prefix removed when present. The second buffer contains the record source as UTF-8. Return an empty array for empty input. Do not mutate the inputs, and do not expose an input record as the tuple's record object.

Use CommonJS and export exactly `{ packCompiledRecords }` via `module.exports`.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
